text: This report responds to the Toronto and East York Community Council direction for the General Manager, Transportation Services to report on right-of-way permit process and requirements for the Metrolinx Ontario Line project. The report provides an overview of the permit process and requirements for Metrolinx's contractors with an emphasis on requirements for construction notification. The report also provides an overview of Metrolinx's communication program to provide project updates and notifications to various stakeholders, including City Councillors.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Received the report (January 17, 2020) from the Director, Transportation Planning and Capital Program, for information.
